supported_categories.A: Entire vehicle and all parts should be crushed; no parts reuse.
supported_categories.B: Body shell should be crushed; controlled parts reuse may be possible.
supported_categories.N: Repairable salvage without structural damage, where non-structural damage or economics make it salvage.

decision_inputs.entire_vehicle_destroy_required: True where severe damage, contamination, identity, fire, water, or safety evidence means the whole vehicle and all parts should be destroyed.
decision_inputs.bodyshell_crush_required: True where the body shell should be crushed but some parts may be suitable for controlled reuse.
decision_inputs.repairable: True where the vehicle is repairable salvage rather than A/B parts-only disposal.
decision_inputs.structural_damage: True/false when structural involvement is evidenced; null when not proven.
decision_inputs.non_structural_salvage_reason: Reason Cat N remains under consideration despite no structural damage, such as uneconomic repair, theft, electrical, interior, cosmetic, or mechanical damage.
decision_inputs.special_factors: List of fire, water, contamination, HV battery, motorcycle, identity, or parts-reuse factors.

rules.reason: Whole-vehicle destruction is required; do not assess as ordinary repairable salvage.
Body shell destruction is required, with controlled parts reuse only where safe.
Repairable salvage with evidenced structural damage.
Repairable salvage with no evidenced structural damage and a non-structural salvage/economic basis.
